question: Select the correct Synonym of 'PERNICIOUS'.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Deadly**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Pernicious"** refers to something that is highly harmful, destructive, or deadly, especially in a gradual or subtle way. (हानिकारक)
 
 
• **Example:** Smoking has a pernicious effect on health, leading to severe illnesses over time.
